entries.latin:
Gerhardus dei gracia episcopus Herbipolensis dilecto nobis in Christo plebano ecclesie parochialis in Wulchingen nostre dyocesis et singulis plebanis ecclesiarum et capellarum rectoribus per civitatem et dyocesim nostram
ubilibet constitutis salutem in domino sempiternam. Licet dudum ex certis causis contra quondam Eberhardum de Rosenberg militem et nonnullos alios suos consanguineos de Rosenberg in processibus nostris
nominatos et expressatos per diversas sententias excommunicacionis, aggravacionis et interdicti et per intervalla [tria?] a longo tempore processerimus, prout hec et alia in dictis nostris processibus et eciam vicarii nostri tunc plenius
continentur, et maxime super eo quod iidem quondam Eberhardus et Conradus de Rosenberg milites necnon Arnoldus et Conradus armigeri similiter de Rosenberg decimas parochialis ecclesie
in Wulchingen [sitas?] sub quadam vendicione, ut asserunt, per eos facta usurparunt, detinent et occupant de facto et minus iuste. Noviter vero expositum erat nobis, quod prefatus
quondam Eberhardus de Rosenberg miles in campo et prope opidum Luden ab inimicis suis capitalibus sit interemptus et diem suum extremum clauserit viamque universe carnis
sit ingressus. Uxorque sua et filii sui per discretum virum Lupoldum plebanum in Wulchingen nobis supplicare curavit, quatinus intuitu misericordie animam dicti patris eorum ab huiusmodi
sententiis absolvere et sibi ecclesiasticam sepulturam inter fideles annuere dignaremur. Ipsi parati esse volunt et obligant se ad omne ius faciendum coram nobis in dicta causa, ad quod
dictus quondam Eberhardus eorum pater existeret pridem obligatus, et parere vellent pro ipso et pro se iuri et mandatis ecclesie, et super premissis omnibus constituerunt nobis pro fideiussore
prefatum Lupoldum plebanum in Wulchingen, qui corporaliter coram nobis constitutus nobis manuali promissione promisit pro eisdem et fideiussit, quod dicti heredes et uxor predicti causam infra
hinc et festum sancti Martini proxime venturum coram nobis prosequi debebunt et iuri stabunt et mandatis ecclesie atque nostris. Quibus premissis et aliis promissionibus ab Engelhardo
de Rosenberg dicti Eberhardi patruo receptis, per nos ipsum quondam Eberhardum de Rosenberg militem ipsiusque animam duximus ab huiusmodi suis excommunicacionis sententiis absolvendum et absolvimus.
Preterea [?] corpus quoque ipsius mandamus ecclesiastice tradi sepulture. Datum Herbipoli anno domini millesimo trecentesimo octuagesimo septimo sabbato ante festum sancti Johannis Baptiste
nostro sub sigillo appenso.
entries.english:
Gerhard, by the grace of God Bishop of Würzburg, to our beloved in Christ the parish priest of the parish church of Wölchingen in our diocese, and to each and every parish priest and rector of churches and chapels established anywhere throughout our city and diocese: eternal greeting in the Lord.

Some time ago, for certain reasons, we proceeded at length against the late Eberhard von Rosenberg, knight, and several other kinsmen of the von Rosenberg family, named and specified in our processes, by various sentences of excommunication, aggravation and interdict, issued at the prescribed intervals, as is set out more fully in these our processes and in those of our then vicar. This was above all because the said late Eberhard and Konrad von Rosenberg, knights, together with Arnold and Konrad, squires, likewise von Rosenberg, by virtue of a certain sale which, as they claim, was made, usurped the tithes of the parish church of Wölchingen and still hold and occupy them in fact and without just title.

It has now recently been set before us that the said late Eberhard von Rosenberg, knight, was slain in the field near the town of Lauda by his mortal enemies, ended his last day and went the way of all flesh. His wife and sons, through the discreet man Lupold, parish priest of Wölchingen, humbly besought us that, moved by mercy, we would deign to absolve the soul of their father from these sentences and grant him ecclesiastical burial among the faithful. They declared themselves ready, and bound themselves, to do full right before us in the said case, as the late Eberhard their father had formerly been bound to do, and to obey the law and the mandates of the Church on his behalf and their own. In all these matters they appointed as surety to us the said Lupold, parish priest of Wölchingen, who, appearing before us in person, promised for them by a pledge of hand and stood surety that the said heirs and widow would pursue the case before us between now and the next feast of Saint Martin, and would submit to judgement and to the mandates of the Church and to ours.

Having received these pledges, and further promises from Engelhard von Rosenberg, paternal uncle of the said Eberhard, we have seen fit to absolve the late Eberhard von Rosenberg, knight, and his soul from these his sentences of excommunication, and we do so absolve him. Moreover, we order that his body also be given ecclesiastical burial.

Given at Würzburg in the year of the Lord one thousand three hundred and eighty-seven, on the Saturday before the feast of Saint John the Baptist [22 June 1387], under our appended seal.

facts.circumstances: Slain by his mortal enemies in the field near Lauda while under sentences of excommunication.

facts: [vogt_zu_Lauda]'s heirs agreed to pursue the tithe case before the Bishop of Würzburg by the next feast of Saint Martin and submit to Church judgment
Bishop Gerhard of Würzburg permitted church burial of [vogt_zu_Lauda] after receiving his heirs' undertakings and Engelhard's promises
[vogt_zu_Lauda] was in dispute with the Bishop of Würzburg over tithes at Wölchingen
